name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Two fixes. (1) Critical: 0.0.100's season/episode cross-server merge fix had a real bug - episodes or seasons missing a real index number (some shows' metadata gaps, multi-part specials) all fell back to a shared placeholder number, silently merging dozens of genuinely distinct episodes into one and deleting the rest as superseded duplicates. Confirmed live: several shows lost the vast majority of their episodes this way. Merging by number now only happens when a real number is actually reported; anything without one keeps its own entry per source instead, same as before 0.0.100 - never destructive, worst case still just a duplicate. (2) HDR and Dolby Vision were never detected for any Plex-sourced content, and only one audio track was ever captured per item: the bulk section-listing endpoint used to sync every item only ever reports a bare codec name, never real color/HDR data - confirmed against a real 4K Dolby Vision/HDR10 remux that the listing endpoint didn't distinguish from an ordinary SDR file. Media details are now fetched from each item's own detail endpoint, which reports a full per-stream breakdown (real HDR10/Dolby Vision classification, every audio track, not just one) - falling back to the old summary-only behavior if that fetch fails. 269 tests, all green.
